# True Fix A/C & Heating

> Air conditioning & heating based in Katy, Texas. True Fix repairs, installs and maintains home and light commercial A/C and heating across Katy, Fulshear and Cinco Ranch. Customers of many years say the techs show up on time and tell you exactly what is wrong.

- Phone: (281) 392-9334
- Based in: Katy, TX
- Service area: Katy, Fulshear, Cinco Ranch, Richmond, Brookshire, West Houston
- Google rating: 4.9 from 51 reviews
- Request a quote: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/true-fix-ac-heating/quote.html

## Services
- A/C repair: Diagnosis and repair on all parts of your cooling system, with a straight answer about what failed and why.
- A/C installation & replacement: New Trane systems sized for your home, installed by True Fix's own crew, never subcontractors.
- Heating & furnaces: Furnace repair and installation so the house stays warm through a Katy cold snap.
- Heat pumps & mini-splits: Heat pumps and ductless mini-splits for whole homes, additions, garages and rooms that never cool right.
- Ductwork & indoor air: Attic duct replacement and indoor air quality upgrades that move more air and keep it cleaner.
- Worry-Free Maintenance: Spring and fall checkups that catch small problems early. Many customers have been on the plan for years.

## About
True Fix A/C & Heating has been family and locally owned since 1972. The line on its vans and home-show banners says it plainly: Living in Katy, Working in Katy and Katy proud. You will spot the vans parked by the red caboose in Old Town Katy. True Fix is a Trane Comfort Specialist dealer. Its technicians are NATE certified, factory trained and background checked, and the company does not use subcontractors. Homes, churches, city offices and light commercial buildings rely on them, and most new customers come by referral.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Are you a Trane dealer?
  A: Yes. True Fix is a Trane Comfort Specialist dealer in Katy, and its NATE-certified technicians install and service Trane systems.
- Q: What is the Worry-Free Maintenance Program?
  A: It is True Fix's maintenance plan: twice-a-year checkups of your A/C and heating. Many Katy customers have kept their systems on it for years.
- Q: Is your work guaranteed?
  A: Yes. Repairs carry a 1-year labor repair warranty, and the work is backed by a 100% performance guarantee.
- Q: Do you send subcontractors?
  A: No. Every visit is handled by True Fix's own background-checked, factory-trained technicians.
- Q: Is financing available for a new system?
  A: Yes. Financing is available through Wells Fargo for qualifying system replacements.
- Q: Where are you, and when are you open?
  A: 25218 Lakeview Rd in Katy, open weekdays 8 to 5. Emergency service is available.
